---

**Why two sections?** A vendor that does not publish a geographic restriction has
not confirmed that it serves your country. Our own region groupings are a display
aid and are never treated as proof — a vendor saying "APAC" does not establish
that a startup in Pakistan can apply. Only the vendor's own words put a program
in the confirmed list. See the
[verification policy](../docs/verification-policy.md).
